title: Programme binding (.github/toolkit-programme.json)
description: Non-secret binding in a governed repository: the parent issue, record prefixes, the private state store and the checks that count as required. Repository identity comes from the origin remote and GitHub; this file must agree and cannot override it.

kind.description: The store backend. This version ships github: a separate private repository written through the Contents API.

repository.description: A separate private repository; verified private and writable before every pass.

required_checks.description: Check names that count as required at the PR head, in addition to the checks GitHub marks required. With none of either, checks are never GREEN.
